description: Use this when you want to prepare a message without sending it yet. Requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (required; inbox id, username, or email), to, cc, bcc, reply_to, subject, text, html, attachments, labels, headers, in_reply_to or forward_of (one source message; not both), reply_all (only with in_reply_to), include_attachments (forward only; default true), send_at (optional ISO-8601 timestamp; sets the scheduled label and send_status scheduled), client_id (optional). Reply recipients and Re: come from the source message, so omit to on a reply. A forward keeps your text and merges the original body and attachments when it sends. A held source message returns HTTP 409 message_held. Returns the draft. The same client_id returns the original draft and does not create another. send_at on an inbox whose send_mode is approval emails verified owners. No verified owner returns HTTP 409 owner_required and stores nothing.

attachments.description: Files to store on the draft. Each item is {filename, content_base64, content_type?, content_id?}.

cc.description: Cc addresses. On a reply these are merged with the derived recipients.

client_id.description: Idempotency key. The same value returns the original draft.

forward_of.description: Message id to forward. Mutually exclusive with in_reply_to.

in_reply_to.description: Message id to reply to. Mutually exclusive with forward_of.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address

include_attachments.description: On a forward, copy the original attachments when the draft sends. Default true.

labels.description: Labels to set. The scheduled label is reserved.

reply_all.description: When true with in_reply_to, address the whole thread. Requires in_reply_to.

reply_to.description: Reply-To address, or a comma-separated list.

send_at.description: ISO-8601 time to send. Null is ignored on create. Must be within 366 days.

subject.description: Subject. A reply or forward fills this from the source message when omitted.

to.description: Recipient addresses. Omit on a reply. An empty list clears them on update.

name: cooper_create_draft
title: Create a draft
